title: Character-graded Schenzel Hilbert series for a Buchsbaum complex with a free cyclic prime-order action
author: Sawaske, Connor
work: Stanley–Reisner rings of simplicial complexes with a free action by an abelian group
source_version: Algebraic Combinatorics 1 (2018), no.5,677-695; DOI10.5802/alco.29; publisher ALCO_Sawaske_103.tex

contexts.scope: Entire author mathematical body; character-equivariant localcohomology/Koszulcore preserved. Other claims contextonly.

difficulty_reason: The character-graded formula requires tracking the cyclic action through Hom, Ext and local cohomology rather than applying the ordinary ungraded Schenzel formula. Its nonroutine local core constructs a G-equivariant cochain isomorphism and checks the compatible character shifts along the Artinian-reduction exact sequences. The resulting simultaneous character multiplicity calculation for all degrees of a Buchsbaum complex exceeds ordinary PhD qualification computations; that authored equivariance argument is retained in full.
